name: Allopurinol
status: DRAFT – pharmacology (†) is not yet checked against the package insert; doses are extracted automatically from the guideline text
dagger_note: † = general pharmacology; not in the SA guideline and not yet checked against the package insert
item_format: t=text, s=source:printed page, d=dagger, b=bold, h=heading

moa.t: Blocks conversion of hypoxanthine and xanthine to uric acid

dosing_note: Doses are extracted automatically from the guideline text. Each heading is the nearest section title in the guideline and can be off by one section – confirm on the cited page. The pathway dose stays authoritative for its indication.

items.t: Allopurinol, oral, 100 mg daily. · Increase monthly by 100 mg according to serum urate levels. · Titrate dose to reduce serum urate to <0.35 mmol/L.
Allopurinol, oral, 100 mg 8 hourly. · Maximum dose: 300 mg 8 hourly. · Adjust dose to 50 mg 8 hourly, if eGFR <20 mL/minute.
Allopurinol, oral, 100 mg daily (Doctor initiated). · Increase monthly by 100 mg according to serum urate levels. · Titrate dose to reduce serum urate to <0.35 mmol/L.

contraindications.t: Do not start during an acute gout attack

cautions.t: Stop at the first sign of rash
Greatly increases azathioprine and mercaptopurine toxicity

adverse_effects.t: Rash, severe cutaneous reactions (SJS/TEN, DRESS), GI upset, hepatitis
